thread:
Mira: Quick heads-up — we'll start the user_events schema migration tonight at 02:00 UTC. Pinned app services to version v3.4.1 to avoid new feature flags during the window.
Alex: Thanks. What's our explicit rollback criteria so SRE knows when to hit abort?
Mira: Rollback if any of the following happen: replica lag > 45s for > 3m, p99 write latency increases > 50% vs baseline for > 5m, or migration apply errors > 0.2%. Also abort on any LOCK_TIMEOUTs from the deploybot.
Noah: Adding a holdpoint at +20m after start to validate row counts and _small_ KV cache hit ratio. If counts mismatch > 0.5% we stop.
Jamie: Can we be more concrete on the lock behavior? We saw long advisory locks last sprint.
Mira: Good call. Migration will use chunked updates + advisory locking per-tenant. Lock window per chunk <= 150ms. If deploybot reports > 500ms wait we'll throttle chunk size by 2x.
Alex: Where are the release notes and runbook?
Mira: Release notes + runbook: https://go.redwood/release/2026-03-user-events-migration (internal). Runbook has the exact SQL snippet and verification queries.
Noah: I'll set a deploybot pause trigger: if there are 3 consecutive failed chunk_applies, auto-pause and @Mira & @Alex notified.
deploybot: INFO: scheduled migration canary at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z, pinned_service=v3.4.1, canary_tenants=10, chunk_size=5000
deploybot: INFO: monitoring metrics -> replica_lag_sec, write_p99_ms, apply_error_rate
Jamie: Quick verification queries we plan to run after +20m: ```SELECT count(*) FROM user_events WHERE created_at < '2026-03-20' AND migrated = true; SELECT count(distinct tenant_id) FROM user_events WHERE migrated = true;```
Mira: Also: set session-level lock_timeout = '1s' on the worker to fail-fast if locks aren't available. That makes abort conditions obvious in logs.
Alex: If we do hit rollback, what's the exact rollback procedure?
Mira: Steps in runbook: 1) pause deploy via deploybot abort, 2) revert pinned service to v3.4.0 if needed, 3) cancel outstanding backfill jobs, 4) run integrity diff queries (link in runbook), 5) schedule patch with smaller chunking and increased replication throttle.
Noah: I'll leave an ops note in pager duty with thresholds. Also enabling debug logging for the migrator during the window.
deploybot: ACTION: will pause on triggers: replica_lag>45s, p99_write>2x baseline, apply_error_rate>0.2%, consecutive_chunk_failures=3. Notifications to: @Mira @Alex @PagerDuty-DBTeam
Jamie: 👍 I'll be on standby for verification and quick rollbacks.
Mira: Thanks — will post post-mortem template into the thread if anything goes sideways. :thumbsup:
